Name: Redis Server Unprotected by Password Authentication
Synopsis: The remote Redis server does not require authentication.
Description: The Redis server running on the remote host is not protected by password authentication. A remote attacker can exploit this to gain unauthorized access to the server, read and modify data, and in some configurations execute commands.
Solution: Enable the 'requirepass' directive in the redis.conf configuration file.
